name: Golden Hour Gemstone Necklace
sizes: 16-18 inches; Adjustable chain extender for a flexible fit
materials: Natural gemstones-tiger eye, sunstone, rhodochrosite, jade, labradorite, banded citrine, garnet, quartz, Czech glass spacers, hematite spacers, PVD gold grounds; gold filled 14/20 clasp, chain, components
description: A lively mix of blush, berry, cherry red, warm amber, and smoky tones gives this necklace its one-of-a-kind, color-blocked look. Smooth and faceted beads are finished with petite gold accents, a lobster clasp, and a delicate blush beads. Wear it as your colorful statement piece or layer it with a simple gold chain.
